module.purpose: Defines shared Flow type aliases and interfaces for React core abstractions used across packages: nodes, context, suspense, transitions, debugging, profiling.
module.summary: This module is a central Flow type declaration file in React's shared package. It contains no runtime code, only compile-time type contracts. It exports numerous type aliases and interfaces describing React's abstract types: ReactNode, ReactKey, context providers/consumers, portals, scopes, thenables for Suspense, error/async debug info, view transitions, gestures, and built-in component prop shapes (Suspense, Profiler, Activity, etc.). These types are consumed by React renderers and reconcilers to maintain cross-package type safety.
module.businessContext: Provides the foundational type vocabulary for React's internal type checking. If missing or incorrect, Flow type checks across React renderers and libraries break, undermining developer tooling.
systemCapabilities: Encode React internal component prop shapes

Awaited
publicSignatures.signature:
export type Awaited<T> = T extends null | void
  ? T // special case for `null | undefined` when not in `--strictNullChecks` mode
  : T extends Object // `await` only unwraps object types with a callable then. Non-object types are not unwrapped.
    ? T extends {then(onfulfilled: infer F): any} // thenable, extracts the first argument to `then()`
      ? F extends (value: infer V) => any // if the argument to `then` is callable, extracts the argument
        ? Awaited<V> // recursively unwrap the value
        : empty // the argument to `then` was not callable.
      : T // argument was not an object
    : T; // non-thenable
